result.markdown:
# Power Outage Incident on Site S-SAH-005 in Sahel

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-SAH-005`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence of MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, and SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-005 perfectly aligns with KPI drop timings; changes and maintenance windows were checked and ruled out. External events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 02:15 to 2026-09-11 03:32
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 00:19
- **Affected:** S-SAH-005

## Summary

A mains power failure on site S-SAH-005 caused battery depletion and a subsequent site down event leading to complete loss of availability and traffic.

Site S-SAH-005 experienced a total outage where availability and active users dropped to zero starting around 2026-09-11 02:15 until recovery at 2026-09-11 03:32 when mains power was restored and alarms cleared.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-10 22:55: Parameter tuning change CHG-2026-0028 applied on S-SAH-005 for handover hysteresis fine-tuning. [CHG-2026-0028, T3]
- 2026-09-11 00:19: Major MAINS_FAILURE alarm ALM-000197 raised on S-SAH-005. [ALM-000197, T2]
- 2026-09-11 02:12: Major BATTERY_LOW alarm ALM-000198 raised on S-SAH-005 as backup power depleted. [ALM-000198, T2]
- 2026-09-11 02:15: Earliest KPI onset detected: S-SAH-005 availability_pct fell below baseline. [T6, ALR-0011]
- 2026-09-11 02:27: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm ALM-000199 raised on S-SAH-005. [ALM-000199, T2]
- 2026-09-11 02:30: Availability and active users on S-SAH-005 dropped to minimum (0). [T6, ANM-000159, ANM-000160]
- 2026-09-11 03:32: All site alarms (ALM-000197, ALM-000198, ALM-000199) cleared upon power restoration and site recovery. [ALM-000197, ALM-000198, ALM-000199, T2]

## Evidence

- Detector alert ALR-0011 recorded an anomaly on site S-SAH-005 involving active_users, availability_pct, and dl_volume_mb starting from 2026-09-11 02:15. [ALR-0011, T1]
- Major MAINS_FAILURE alarm occurred on S-SAH-005 at 2026-09-11 00:19, preceding the site outage by roughly two hours before clearing at 2026-09-11 03:32. [ALM-000197, T2]
- Battery low and site down alarms triggered sequentially at 2026-09-11 02:12 and 2026-09-11 02:27. [ALM-000198, ALM-000199, T2]
- KPI metrics availability_pct and active_users dropped to 0 at 2026-09-11 02:30, matching the site down progression. [T6, ANM-000159, ANM-000160]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-SAH-005 or its parent elements during the incident window. [T4]

## Inferences

- Parameter tuning change CHG-2026-0028 occurred on S-SAH-005 hours before the outage and did not cause a crash. [CHG-2026-0028, T3]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-SAH-005: confirmed. Direct sequence of mains failure, battery exhaustion, and site down alarms conclusively explain the exact zero-availability window which recovered when power restored. [ALM-000197, ALM-000198, ALM-000199, T2]
2. **bad_change** at S-SAH-005: rejected. The configuration change CHG-2026-0028 was routine parameter tuning hours prior and uncorrelated with a hard power failure sequence. [CHG-2026-0028, T3]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-SAH-005: rejected. No maintenance window was scheduled for S-SAH-005 or its parent nodes during the timeframe. [T4]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0028: Parameter tuning change on S-SAH-005 completed hours prior to the outage and did not cause a power or site failure.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect

confounders.why: Harmless parameter_tuning on S-SAH-005 84 min before the mains failure; the site went down hours later, when the batteries ran out, and neighbours with the same change were unaffected.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; Mains failure at S-SAH-005; the batteries lasted 2.1 h, so the KPIs stayed normal until they were exhausted. Trap: a parameter change on S-SAH-005 itself ran 84 min before the mains failure, so a hasty investigator blames it for the site going down. Settled by: (1) MAINS_FAILURE (major) and later BATTERY_LOW precede the SITE_DOWN, which is the power sequence, and a parameter change cannot cut the mains; (2) the KPIs were normal for hours after the change; (3) the same tuning went onto S-SAH-010, S-SAH-011 under the same ticket and they stayed up.
